shared_elements: relief carving on an upright stone slab/pillar
large arched animal forms along the top
horizontal band of repeated triangular/chevron pattern
animals or birds in profile in the middle field
long sinuous line or snake-like form
lower vertical field with elongated figure/animal motifs
justification: The strongest correspondence is the same stacked scheme: broad top with arched animals, a narrow chevron/triangle band below, then profile creatures and sinuous forms over a lower vertical panel. The biggest difference is that A is a clear frontal view with more legible individual figures, while B is oblique, partly shadowed, and some motifs are harder to confirm or appear differently spaced.
